question: A 5-year-old girl presents with acute right hip pain and fever. Her Kocher predictors are: WBC > 12,000/mm³ (present), ESR > 40 mm/hr (present), fever > 38.5°C (present), and non-weight-bearing (present). All four predictors are present. Which statement best describes the clinical implication?

answers.text: The predicted probability of septic arthritis is approximately 99%, and operative joint drainage is warranted without further delay

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Correct. With all four Kocher predictors present, the predicted probability of septic arthritis approaches 99% (Kocher et al., JBJS 1999). This threshold justifies proceeding directly to operative drainage — diagnostic aspiration in theatre is both diagnostic and therapeutic.

answers.text: The predicted probability is approximately 40%, so MRI confirmation is required before operating

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: A 40% probability corresponds to two Kocher predictors. With all four present, the probability is ~99%. Waiting for MRI when four predictors are positive introduces harmful delay.

answers.text: The predicted probability is approximately 73%, so joint aspiration under ultrasound guidance is required to confirm pus before proceeding

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: 73% corresponds to three Kocher predictors. With all four present, the probability is ~99%, which is the threshold for proceeding directly to operative washout.

answers.text: The Kocher criteria only apply if CRP is also elevated; without CRP the score cannot be interpreted

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: The original Kocher criteria use WBC, ESR, temperature, and weight-bearing status — CRP was not part of the original four predictors (though later modifications added it). The four-predictor model remains valid.

overallFeedback.feedback: Commit the Kocher probability ladder to memory: 0→<0.2%, 1→3%, 2→40%, 3→93%, 4→99%. With four predictors the diagnosis is virtually certain; delay for further imaging is not justified and risks avascular necrosis.
Excellent recall of Kocher thresholds. 0 predictors ≈ <0.2%; 1 ≈ 3%; 2 ≈ 40%; 3 ≈ 93%; 4 ≈ 99%. Four predictors = operate.
